title: He Hated All Women, Until He Met the Mother of His Secret Child
description: A man who has sworn off women is forced to reconsider everything when he discovers the mother of his secret child. A roughly 2-hour YouTube upload that reportedly drew nearly 9.9 million views after its August 2026 release.

audienceReactions.quote: At last a proper full 2hr film , worthy of being made into a real life film, excellent fast paced and no over bearing music
audienceReactions.author: @wolfgirl1-01

audienceReactions.quote: Finally a different storyline without exaggerated actors
